title: Vector gun
subtitle: Operating modes
noGun: The party does not have the gun.

mana.name: Mana bullets
mana.effect: Attack damage uses INT instead of the weapon's own scaling.

recoil.name: Vector recoil
recoil.effect: Targets hit are knocked back and floated.

solomonIncantation.name: Solomon incantation
solomonIncantation.desc: Spells are spoken aloud and deal 15% more damage.
solomonIncantation.effect: Runs only with the Grimoire of Solomon fitted, or while the book is open in Graceful Death. Every spell cast is read out in full first, in a box of its own, and then deals or heals 15% more.

card.name: Card
card.effect: A killing blow adds that enemy's monster card to the collection.

wide.name: Wide shots
wide.desc: Hits several body parts for less damage.
wide.effect: Lower total damage, split across several body parts per attack.

psi.name: Psi vectors
psi.effect: Attack damage uses PSI instead of the weapon's own scaling.

burst.name: Burst fire
burst.desc: Two shots per attack at 70% damage.
burst.effect: Each attack fires twice at 70% damage.

drain.name: Vampiric vectors
drain.effect: The user recovers HP equal to 25% of damage dealt.

siphon.name: Mana siphon
siphon.effect: The user recovers MP equal to 15% of damage dealt.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.effect: Critical hit chance increases by 40 points.

overload.name: Overload
overload.effect: The coilgun's rack of shots is doubled. All shots deal 85% damage.

hex.name: Hexed rounds
hex.effect: A hit has a 40% chance to inflict one of: blind, silence, unbalance, vulnerability, broken guard.

longshot.name: Long shot
longshot.effect: Doubles weapon range on the battle map, in any ranged form.

venom.name: Venom rounds
venom.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict poison.

concussion.name: Concussive rounds
concussion.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict stun.

thermalOverload.name: Thermal overload
thermalOverload.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict burning.

thermalUnderload.name: Thermal underload
thermalUnderload.effect: A hit has a 30% chance to inflict freeze.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc: More damage to low HP targets.
executioner.effect: Damage rises as target HP falls, up to +60% against a target near death.

ambush.name: Ambush protocol
ambush.effect: Attacks made in the first turn of a battle deal 150% damage.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.effect: Damage rises with the user's current MP, up to +40% at full MP.

overpressure.name: Overpressure
overpressure.desc: 135% damage, 2 coilgun shots per round fired.
overpressure.effect: Each shot deals 135% damage and counts as 2 of the coilgun's shots.

hollowPoint.name: Hollow point
hollowPoint.effect: Critical hits deal 75% more damage. Does not change critical rate.

deepMagazine.name: Deep magazine
deepMagazine.effect: The coilgun holds 4 more shots before it folds back. Damage unchanged.

toast.unracked: Coilgun spent, folded back into the pistol.
toast.noSky: No sky in here to turn over.
toast.spent: {form} spent, folded back into the pistol.

locked.equip: Only Em can equip the vector gun.
locked.part: The vector gun cannot leave Em.

element.title: Element
element.hint: The element is stored on the pistol. Weapon forms drop it and attack without an element. The coilgun has its own element, set on the Calibration page, so the frame can hold two at once.

desc.2: Fire damage, can set the target burning.
desc.3: Ice damage, can freeze the target.
desc.8: Holy damage, extra effective against undead.

form.gain: Weapon form: +{bonus}% damage and a gimmick of its own, set on the Calibration page. It gives up the operating modes and the element, which both belong to the gun.
form.gunGain: Base form: the pistol carries the element and is the only shape the operating modes run on. SWITCH racks it out into the coilgun, which carries an element of its own.

gun.name: Vector pistol
gun.desc: Base form. Uses the element and the mode bays.
gun.effect: With no other form fitted, SWITCH converts the pistol into a coilgun sniper rifle: 3 shots, 4x range on the battle map. The third shot folds it back into the pistol. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round.

abrasax.name: Athame of Abrasax
abrasax.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and dagger. In dagger form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

thelema.name: Blade of Thelema
thelema.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and machete. In machete form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

Only one alternate form can be fitted.

kia.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and gauntlet. In gauntlet form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

longinus.name: Lance of Longinus
longinus.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and lance. In lance form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

sniper.name: Coilgun
sniper.effect: 3 shots, 4x range. The last shot reverts it to the pistol.

solomon.name: Grimoire of Solomon
solomon.effect: Fitted, the book is already open when the fight starts: Em begins every battle reading, with a row of spells out of the grimoire instead of her own. It is a pact, not a gift. Graceful Death buys no turn of invulnerability with it, and the book gives back no health: it takes health for every spell read, priced on what the spell costs to cast. Only one alternate form can be fitted. A plain attack with the book is not a blow: it drives open and fires its own pages at what she is aiming at, four tiles out.

fists.name: Fists of Em
fists.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and bare hands. In bare hands form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. She drops the gun outright and fights with her hands. A swing has a chance of becoming one of the martial arts forms chosen on the Calibration page, paid for in AP. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

twin.name: Twin vectors
twin.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a pair of pistols. In a pair of pistols form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. The frame splits down its own seam into two. The Calibration page sets how many rounds an attack puts out, and the more it fires the less each one carries. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

crossbow.name: Vector crossbow
crossbow.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a crossbow. In a crossbow form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. Cocked rather than drawn, and it holds exactly one bolt. The Calibration page sets what is on the end of it. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

eris.name: Nunchaku of Eris
eris.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and nunchaku. In nunchaku form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. Two batons on a lit chain. The Calibration page sets how wild the blow is: the wider the band the better it does on average and the less any one swing can be counted on. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

maat.name: Mail of Maat
maat.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a chained flail. In a chained flail form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. A haft, a run of chain and an ankh for a head. The Calibration page sets what it weighs the target against: the further out of balance, the harder it comes down. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

bubba.name: Wrench of Bubba
bubba.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a wrench. In a wrench form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. A tool built for one job. The Calibration page names the kinds of creature it was built for: far more against those, and less against everything else. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

yaldabaoth.name: Chainsaw of Yaldabaoth
yaldabaoth.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a chainsaw. In a chainsaw form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. The bar reads how far gone the body already is and bites the harder for it. The Calibration page sets which reading it takes. Against something untouched it is worth less than a plain swing. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

nyarlathotep.name: Scythe of Nyarlathotep
nyarlathotep.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a scythe. In a scythe form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. On a critical hit it reaps: a coin toss takes a life outright. The Calibration page sets which side it may take from. It never takes Em, and it cannot touch a boss, a petrodemon, or anything more than ten levels above her. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

freud.name: Katana of Freud
freud.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a katana. In a katana form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. The one blade not swung with the arm: the blow is worked out from PSI. A swing has a chance of becoming the psychic skill chosen on the Calibration page, paid for in AP. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

gautama.name: Rosary of Gautama
gautama.effect: In battle the reload command becomes SWITCH, toggling between gun and a rosary. In a rosary form the weapon uses that weapon type's damage, animation and sound, and costs no ammo. Switching is free: it costs no turn, leaves no guard up and can be done any number of times in a round. The one shape that does not strike. Its attack is turned on her own side instead, and the Calibration page sets what the beads mend. It carries no element and runs no operating mode: both stay on the gun. Only one alternate form can be fitted.

lash.desc: Lowers this parameter on hit for a few rounds. 45% chance, 85% damage.

Blunt.name: Blunt
Blunt.desc: Blunt damage. Effective against bones and armour.

Cutting.name: Cutting
Cutting.desc: Cutting damage. Effective against flesh and soft targets.

Piercing.name: Piercing
Piercing.desc: Piercing damage. Effective against joints and weak points.

Explosive.name: Explosive
Explosive.desc: Explosive damage. Spread across every body part.

double.name: Two
double.desc: Hits two targets at 72% damage each.

triple.name: Three
triple.desc: Hits three targets at 50% damage each.

reach.name: Held out
reach.desc: Range 4 tiles instead of 2. Normal damage.

splitting.name: Splitting head
splitting.desc: Hits every body part at 70% damage.

health.name: Their wounds
health.desc: More damage the lower the target's HP.

mana.name: Their reservoir
mana.desc: More damage the lower the target's MP.

states.name: What they carry
states.desc: More damage for every state on the target.

level.name: The gap between you
level.desc: More damage the bigger the level gap, in either direction.

wound.name: The wound
wound.desc: More damage the more overall damage the target's body has taken.

ruin.name: The ruin
ruin.desc: More damage the worse the target's most damaged part is.

tally.name: The tally
tally.desc: More damage for every body part the target has lost.

patron.name: Patron
patron.desc: 20% chance to reap an enemy on a critical hit. Normal damage.

tithe.name: Tithe
tithe.desc: 50% chance to reap an ally on a critical hit. 130% damage.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.desc: 50% chance to reap anyone on a critical hit. 110% damage.

state.name: An affliction
state.desc: Removes one state from the target.

party.name: All of them
party.desc: Restores a smaller amount of HP to the whole party.

22.desc: Counter Attack: strikes back when hit.

55.desc: Combo: attacks chain into extra hits.

gun.hint: The coilgun has its own element, so the frame holds two at once. Rack depth is up to you, but a doubled rack doubles the ammo cost of every shot.

abrasax.hint: Applies one affliction. Harsher afflictions have lower odds of landing, and PSI raises the odds.

thelema.hint: A normal attack sometimes becomes this sword skill instead, paying its AP cost. The skill does not need to be learned.

freud.hint: Damage is based on PSI. A normal attack sometimes becomes this skill instead, paying its AP cost.

fists.hint: A normal attack sometimes becomes a random form from the selected set, paying its AP cost.

kia.hint: The stance is active while the gauntlet is equipped, and lowers the damage you deal while it is up.

hadit.hint: Switching to the staff changes the weather to this one. Weather affects enemies too, and has no effect indoors.

solomon.hint: The pact is drawn from the selected schools. With nothing selected it draws from every school. A very narrow selection may have nothing to draw.

choronzon.hint: The damage type dealt. It decides what the attack is strong and weak against.

babalon.hint: How many targets the attack hits. Every extra target lowers the damage dealt to all of them.

nuit.hint: The lash lowers one parameter instead of dealing full damage. The attack deals less damage in exchange.

aiwass.hint: How far the bow is drawn. Longer draw trades off against arrow damage.

zos.hint: The status effect on the darts, taken from the same loaded rounds.

baphomet.hint: What the talons drain from the target. Draining AP costs the most, since AP powers attacks that turn into skills.

longinus.hint: How the lance attacks. Each mode trades one property for another.

twin.hint: How many rounds each attack fires. More rounds means less damage per round.

crossbow.hint: The tip loaded on the bolt. Only one can be loaded at a time.

eris.hint: Damage variance. Wider variance raises the average damage but makes single hits less predictable.

maat.hint: The parameter the ankh weighs the target against. A balanced target takes less damage than from a normal attack.

bubba.hint: The target type the wrench is built for. Much more damage against it, less against everything else.

yaldabaoth.hint: The reading the bar takes from the target. Against an unaffected target it deals less than a normal attack.

nyarlathotep.hint: Which side the reaping targets. It never takes Em, and cannot target a boss, a petrodemon, or anything more than ten levels above her.

gautama.hint: What the rosary heals. It deals no damage at all.
